sn48.19:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn48.19:2.2: kittāvatā nu kho bhante indriyasampanno hotīti.
sn48.19:2.3: idha bhikkhu bhikkhu saddhindriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ viriyindriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ satindriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ samādhindriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ paññindriyaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ.
sn48.19:2.4: ettāvatā kho bhikkhu bhikkhu indriyasampanno hotīti.
